description: Implementation of HTTP/2 frame decoder class, handling decoding states, payload processing, and frame-specific decoding routines.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP/2 frames, managing decoding states, and dispatching to specific payload decoders.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to print the state of the Http2FrameDecoder.

methods.name: Http2FrameDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with a listener.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener for frame events.

methods.name: listener
methods.description: Returns the current listener.

methods.name: DecodeFrame
methods.description: Main method to decode a frame from the buffer.

methods.name: remaining_payload
methods.description: Returns the remaining payload size to be decoded.

methods.name: remaining_padding
methods.description: Returns the remaining padding size.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the payload based on frame header.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding payload when previous decoding was incomplete.

methods.name: RetainFlags
methods.description: Retains only specified flags in the frame header.

methods.name: ClearFlags
methods.description: Clears all flags in the frame header.

methods.name: StartDecodingDataPayload

methods.description: Resumes decoding a DATA frame payload.

methods.description: Resumes decoding a PRIORITY frame payload.

methods.description: Resumes decoding a PUSH_PROMISE frame payload.

methods.name: StartDecodingRstStreamPayload
